title: Argentinian Casserole with Chestnut and Oozy Sauce
description: A hearty German-inspired casserole featuring the flavors of Argentina, with a rich and creamy sauce.
instructions: Cook the Argentinian sausage in a pan over medium heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the sliced chestnut mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
In a separate saucepan, heat the oozy cheese sauce over low heat, stirring occasionally.
In the casserole dish, combine the cooked sausage and mushroom mixture. Top with the heated cheese sauce.
Sprinkle the crushed peppery bread over the top of the casserole.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
